text: Objectives The graduate program in Materials Science and Engineering aims to provide solid theory and systematic technological knowledge to our students so that they will be able to engage in high level teaching and researching in the field of Materials Science and Engineering, and assume leadership role in their future work. We encourage our students to be independent, innovative, and socially responsible with good professional ethics. Duration Duration of the program is between 1.5 to 2 years with course works in the first year, followed by a thesis project. Research Areas 1. Information Functional Materials 2. Advanced Energy Materials 3. Biomaterials 4. Electronic Packaging 5. Nanomaterials Credit Units Students need to successfully complete at least 29 credits with 16 credits for degree courses. Scholarships 1.The Shenzhen Universiade International Scholarship 2.HITSZ Scholarship
